channel.title: Lectures in History

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Historian and former Harvard University president Drew Gilpin Faust reflects on the life and legacy of President James Buchanan. Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday this year.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Mathew Brady Story and the Clara Barton Story
channel.desc: This 1961 U.S. Army film tells the stories about both famed Civil War photographer Mathew Brady and Clara Barton, founder of the American Red Cross in 1881.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: The Presidency
channel.desc: Historian Diana Carlin analyzes the life of Julia Grant using the first lady's memoirs. The Ulysses S. Grant Historic Site hosts this event.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: C-SPAN Visits the Golden Spike National Historic Site

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US
channel.title: America 250
channel.desc: Harvard University history professor Annette Gordon-Reed reflects on the life and legacy of President Andrew Johnson. Her essay is part of a project called In Pursuit, commissioned to help mark America's 250th birthday in 2026.

channel.name: CSPAN 2 US

When Noah goes off to serve in World War II, it seems to mark the end of their love affair. In the interim, Allie becomes involved with another man (James Marsden). channel.title: Selena
channel.desc: In this biographical drama, Selena Quintanilla (Jennifer Lopez) is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete.[(96057)]
